channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, Writers, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, Writers, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 1 new Writers prize - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Berggruen Prize Essay Competition 2026: A New Axial Age?
    https://berggruen.org/eu/essay-competition-open
    Berggruen Institute · deadline Closed 17 Aug 2026 · USD 50,000 for the winning English essay and USD 50,000 for the winning Chinese essay. If there is more than one winner in a language category, the prize is split evenly. Winning essays are published through BI Press or Noema. No entry fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
